scientific_integrity: Exact finite calculation with integer chains, 79-pair acyclic Morse matching, complete enumeration of 432 affine maps and signed Lefschetz traces. Reproduction code and original output embedded. The nonequivariant homotopy equivalence is prior work, not the new claim.
scientific_limitations: Only the full rational character, the integral degree-two sign, and rational acyclicity of the affine quotient are determined. The complete integral degree-three lattice, integral quotient torsion, irreducible constituents, and definitive publication priority are not established. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: The affine symmetry character and rationally acyclic quotient of the nine-point cap complex
